knownExclusions: A PASS is not inferred from a monolithic full-package drawing.
caseContract.purpose: Separate graphical monolith proof from true shared-identity independently placeable unit semantics
caseContract.title: FPGA multi-unit probe

record.notes: The monolithic drawing is visually valid. True independently placeable multi-unit semantics are evaluated separately and reported NOT_SUPPORTED.

explicitExclusions: No KiCad or OrCAD native format compatibility.
No DWG/DXF round trip or AutoCAD Dynamic Block behavior.
No 3D/B-rep, PCB footprint, SPICE, or screenshot-recognition capability claim.

performance.policy: Observed baseline only; future releases may enforce reviewed relative-regression thresholds.

MU.extensionDecision: No speculative core extension was introduced in 0.5.2. A dedicated ADR is required before future multi-unit semantics are implemented.
MU.interpretation: The current model can draw the monolithic FPGA shape, but cannot represent independently placeable unit presentations that share one semantic component identity. Variants were not misused as units.
